readings: For each store, use the rented copy’s inventory.store_id. Sum all payments linked to each rental to get its rental payment total. Exclude rentals with no linked payments from the averages. Compare each rental payment total with the average rental payment total across all stores. For rentals above that average, show the store id, the sum of their rental payment totals, and the average amount by which their rental payment totals exceed that average. Do not round.

For each store, use the rented copy’s inventory.store_id. Sum all payments linked to each rental to get its rental payment total. Exclude rentals with no linked payments from the averages. Compare each rental payment total with the average rental payment total for its own store. For rentals above that store’s average, show the store id, the sum of their rental payment totals, and the average amount by which their rental payment totals exceed that store’s average. Do not round.
queries:
WITH rental_totals AS (
  SELECT i.store_id,
         r.rental_id,
         SUM(p.amount) AS rental_payment_total
  FROM rental AS r
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN payment AS p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  GROUP BY i.store_id, r.rental_id
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(rental_payment_total) AS average_total
  FROM rental_totals
)
SELECT rt.store_id,
       SUM(rt.rental_payment_total) AS total_payments,
       AVG(rt.rental_payment_total - oa.average_total) AS average_excess
FROM rental_totals AS rt
CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
WHERE rt.rental_payment_total > oa.average_total
GROUP BY rt.store_id

WITH rental_totals AS (
  SELECT i.store_id, r.rental_id, SUM(p.amount) AS rental_payment_total
  FROM rental AS r
  JOIN inventory AS i ON i.inventory_id = r.inventory_id
  JOIN payment AS p ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
  GROUP BY i.store_id, r.rental_id
),
store_averages AS (
  SELECT store_id, AVG(rental_payment_total) AS average_rental_payment_total
  FROM rental_totals
  GROUP BY store_id
)
SELECT
  rt.store_id,
  SUM(rt.rental_payment_total) AS total_payments,
  AVG(rt.rental_payment_total - sa.average_rental_payment_total) AS average_excess
FROM rental_totals AS rt
JOIN store_averages AS sa ON sa.store_id = rt.store_id
WHERE rt.rental_payment_total > sa.average_rental_payment_total
GROUP BY rt.store_id
